children: China environmental solutions provider's interim revenue rose 40% yr/yr for six months ended June
Gross profit margin increased to 68.1% from 59.2% in prior-year period
Net profit attributable to owners nearly doubled from prior-year period
Hongcheng expects Target Company facilities, once commissioned, to raise sulphuric acid capacity and bolster downstream output
SULPHURIC ACID PRICING – Higher sulphuric acid selling prices drove revenue, profit and gross margin expansion to 68.1% from 59.2%
HIGHER FINANCE COSTS – Net finance costs rose to RMB8.5 mln from RMB2.3 mln due to higher borrowings and effective interest rates
